headline: 3M India gets ESG rating of 77 from CFC Finlease
summary: 3M India has received an independent Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) rating of 77 from CFC Finlease. The rating reflects the company's performance across sustainability and governance metrics evaluated by the agency. For Indian retail investors, ESG scores increasingly influence institutional portfolio weightings and long-term capital allocation in multinational subsidiaries.
why_it_matters: ESG ratings may influence institutional investor flows.
